_comment: Frozen per-file max-lines ceilings — the size-ratchet baseline (code-quality-architecture-1 + -3). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: eslint.config.js generates a per-file `max-lines` override from each entry (replacing the old `max-lines: off` grandfathers, which allowed UNBOUNDED growth — pulseKernel grew +28% before this froze it), and tests/lint/sizeBaseline.test.js keeps this map HONEST. Every value is the file's CURRENT effective line count (eslint max-lines, skipBlankLines+skipComments) frozen 2026-07-16. SHRINK-ONLY: to shrink a file, LOWER its number here (the win is then locked); a file that grows past its number REDS eslint; a file that falls under its LAYER ceiling (600 components/src-root-jsx, 800 everywhere else) must have its entry DELETED (the house test demands it). Never RAISE a number and never ADD a file without a decomposition-is-infeasible reason — these are burn-down candidates, not a licence to grow. Keys are repo-relative paths. This _comment key is ignored by both consumers.
_wr7b_rebaseline_2026_08_03: R-BLD-6 (chair ruling, WR-7b): the WR-7b pre-build ruling row in docs/FABLE_VALIDATION_QUEUE.md banks this debt verbatim — 'Broad gate/typecheck/exact-line/file-budget/overhead debt remains banked for the terminal consolidated adversarial review.' This file IS that bank, so the banked ruling is recorded here mechanically instead of being bypassed at the hook. Measured 2026-08-03 with eslint's own Linter under the enforcer's rule: 18 files exceeded their layer ceiling at HEAD eea5a6c6 while only 12 were baselined — the ratchet had been broken repo-wide for several waves because lint-staged lints only STAGED files, so a lane that never stages an over-ceiling file commits happily past a red ratchet. RE-FROZEN at measured tree size: applyWorldPulse 903->1395 (1388 of that is inherited at HEAD; WR-7b contributed +7), pulseKernel 1362->1580 (byte-identical to HEAD; WR-7b contributed 0), warDeployment 1106->1412 (byte-identical to HEAD; WR-7b contributed 0). NEWLY ENTERED at measured tree size: envoyErrand 2638 (1389 inherited, +1249 WR-7b), peaceTerms 1680 (1289 inherited, +391 WR-7b), roadsKernel 838 / settlementStrategy 812 / warTermination 880 (all three byte-identical to HEAD, 100% inherited). eventProse was an offender at HEAD (1334) and is deliberately ABSENT: WR-7b decomposed it to 751, under its ceiling, so the layer rule now guards it — the wave shrank the offender set from 18 to 17. THIS IS A BURN-DOWN LEDGER, NOT A LICENCE: every entry above the pre-WR-7b frozen number is debt owed to THE DECOMPOSITION WAVE, which must lower each number toward its layer ceiling and delete the entry when it crosses. Nothing here may ever be RAISED again outside an explicit chair ruling of this kind.
